message.content:
**Analysis**

1) **Large title (תקדימות ובללים):** Both sides use the same heavy/black decorative weight. Letterforms and stroke thickness look essentially identical. ✔ Match.

2) **Smaller subtitle lines (יש חשב... / – השיירות):** Here there is a difference — on the **LEFT (old)** the subtitle lines are noticeably lighter (regular weight), while on the **RIGHT (new)** they render **bolder**. The new engine appears to be applying a bold weight (or synthetic emboldening) to the subtitle text.

3) **Other visual differences:**
- Layout, centering, and the decorated divider (diamond flourish) under the title match.
- Gray side panel: same position, size, and shade on both sides. ✔
- Line-wrapping of the subtitle ("– השיירות" on the second line) matches on both sides. ✔
- The extra boldness of the subtitle on the right makes the text appear slightly wider/denser, but no shift in wrapping occurred.

**Verdict: DIFFERENCES**
- Subtitle lines (below title): old = regular weight, new = bold weight.
